item.title: Essais 1.1
item.description:
• Welcome: choose the font, size, appearance and location the first time you open Essais.
  • Settings: writing, corrections, appearance, notebook and updates in one window.
  • The notebook can now be moved to another folder, such as Dropbox or an external drive.
  • Dates can be shown in English, in Spanish or in the system's language.
  • VoiceOver reads your text without Markdown marks, and the Titles rotor no longer selects the title.

item.title: Essais 1.0
item.description:
• One notebook, one day after another, as plain Markdown files in a folder you can see.
  • An index built from your titles and tags, search, and go to a date.
  • A camera that follows what you write. Pinch to get closer.
  • Four typefaces, any size, light and dark.
